verdict.rationale: Otter documents an official MCP Server that connects meeting data to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools. Through it you can search transcripts across all time periods, pull transcripts and action items, and recap and draft follow-ups. It is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions, so the assistant only reaches meetings you explicitly authorize. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described, detailed tool-level or setup documentation beyond marketing and blog copy, and explicit evidence of compatibility with generic MCP clients beyond Claude and ChatGPT.
